blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A nine-year-old chess prodigy from Talisay City, Cebu, who had already won several major titles and was preparing for a shot at the Philippine National Chess Championship, was laid to rest on Thursday afternoon, November 5, days after he died of dengue. Phil Rholand M. Templonuevo died on October 29 after being hospitalized for a high fever and later diagnosed with dengue. His death cut short a promising chess career that had already brought him multiple championships, including three consecutive Mayor’s Cup titles and a Batang Pinoy national championship.
